exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Noun wo kudasaru".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 名詞をくださる matches "Noun wo kudasaru".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 名詞をくださる.
exercises.explanation: Polite form to say someone of higher status gives you something.
